questions.question:
**In the following question, out of the four alternatives, select the alternative which will improve the bracketed part of the sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select "no improvement".**

Opening the door to her each morning is like (lets) a breath of fresh air into my world.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **Letting**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the given sentence, "letting" functions as a **gerund**, which is a verb form that acts as a noun.
 
• Gerunds are formed by adding -ing to a verb and can be used as subjects, objects, or complements in a sentence.
 
• In the sentence "Opening the door to her each morning is like letting a breath of fresh air into my world," "letting" is a gerund functioning as the direct object of the verb "is like."
 
• The gerund phrase "letting a breath of fresh air into my world" is the object of comparison and is equivalent to "the act of letting a breath of fresh air into my world." It describes the action or process that is being compared to the act of opening the door.
 
• The gerund form "letting" is grammatically appropriate here because it helps convey the idea that the act of opening the door is similar to the act of allowing a breath of fresh air to enter one's world.
 
• It adds a sense of action and movement to the sentence, emphasizing the dynamic nature of the comparison.

Therefore, the correct answer is: *Opening the door to her each morning is like **letting** a breath of fresh air into my world.*

questions.question:
**A sentence has been given in Active/Passive Voice. Out of the four given alternatives, select the one which best expresses the same sentence in Passive/Active Voice.**

Some girls were helping the wounded men.

options.text: The wounded men were helping some girls.
The wounded men were being helped by some girls.
The wounded men are being helped by some girls.
The wounded men received help from some girls.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **The wounded men were being helped by some girls.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• The given **Active voice** is in **Past Continuous Tense.**
 
• Its structure is as follows: **Subject + was/were + (Verb+ing) + object.**
 
• While changing it into Indirect form, its tense will remain same.
 
• Its **Passive voice structure** will be: **Object(subjective case) + was/were + being + Verb₃ form + by + Subject(objective case).** 
 
 
• ​**Ex. Active: **Ram was playing cricket.
 
 

 **Passive:** Cricket was being played by Ram.

Hence, the correct answer is: The wounded men were being helped by some girls.

We know that cosec P = Hypotenuse/Opposite = PR/QR = 17/15

Let the sides PR and QR be 17x and 15x respectively

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4e0e92cc351398bba4f87831322b883e4b68d78c01401724750a58fb9db24ca6.png] 

For the right-angled triangle, as per Pythagoras theorem, PQ² + QR² = PR²

PQ² = PR² - QR²

⇒ PQ² = (17x)² - (15x)² = 289x² - 225x² = 64x²

⇒ PQ = √64x² = 8x

From the figure, Sin R = PQ/PR = 8x/17x = (8/17)

∴ Sin R = (8/17)

questions.question: In a compound, the elements are always present in definite proportions by _______.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **__mass__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The law of definite proportions was stated by Proust as “In a chemical substance the elements are always present in definite proportions by mass”.
 
• And the law of definite proportion does not depend on its source and preparation method.
 
 
• For example, in a compound such as water, the ratio of the mass of hydrogen to the mass of oxygen is always 1:8, whatever the source of water.
 
 
 
• Thus, if 9 g of water is decomposed, 1 g of hydrogen and 8 g of oxygen are always obtained. 
 
• Similarly, nitrogen and hydrogen are always present in the 14:3 mass ratio in ammonia, whatever the preparation method or the source from which it is produced.

questions.question: Which of the following is a CORRECT relation of length of small intestines of an herbivore and a carnivore?
questions.solution:
The Correct answer is __**Herbivore > Carnivore**__

__**Explanation:**__

__
 
• Herbivores are animals that derive energy from just eating plants, whereas carnivores are those animals which derive their energy by eating meat or flesh of other animals.
 
• The small intestine of herbivores is longer in length than carnivores since plant matter is lower in nutrients and is tough to break as compared to animal matter. Therefore, animals who are herbivores need to be efficient digesters so that they can get the necessary amount of nutrients.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Herbivores (Herb=plant, vore= to eat)**
 
• A herbivore is an animal that gets its energy from eating plants and only plants.
 
• A herbivore is an animal anatomically and physiologically adapted to eating plant materials.
 
• Many herbivores have special digestive systems that let them digest all kinds of plants, including grasses.
 
• For example foliage or marine algae, for the main component of its diet.
 
• As a result of their plant diet, herbivorous animals typically have mouthparts adapted to rasping or grinding.
 
• A carnivore is a species that feeds on killing and eating other animals.
 
• Carnivores usually consume herbivores, although they also consume omnivores.
 
• Animals that consume other animals, such as carnivores and omnivores, are vital to every environment, as they prevent other organisms from being overpopulated.
 
• Carnivores are the third trophic level. Omnivores, beings that consume a large range of species, from plants to animals to fungi, are also at the third trophic level.

questions.question: In Microsoft Word, ________ are small dots, squares, dashes or graphics that are often seen before the text.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Bullets**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__****Bullets**

__
 
• In Microsoft Word, bullets are small dots, squares, dashes, or graphics that are often seen before the text.
 
• The bulleted tab is located in the Paragraph group of the **Home tab**.
 
• There are a total of **8 types **of default bullets present in **MS Word 2019.** If "None" is not counted then 7 types.
 
• The bulleted tab has different types of bullet styles that can apply to a document.
 
• There are eight formats in the bulleted tab, with the top-left format being "None." 
 
• Collectively these eight formats are known as a **"gallery."**
 
• To change your style of bullet, press** ALT+ENTER** to bring up the properties box.
